source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The sleep helper accepts Duration and documents failure if its millisecond representation cannot fit in u32. It performs that checked conversion before InitWithCallback and propagates timer creation/initialization errors. A typed duration therefore does not remove the native timer's range limit. No overflow, submillisecond timing, cancellation or native test was run.
title: A typed sleep duration still has a bounded native timer conversion
